title: ...board a cruise ship on embarkation day
desc: Navigate boarding procedures, safety drills, and cabin setup smoothly.
todos: Pack essential meds, documents, and swim gear in day carry-on bag.
Complete mandatory safety muster drill steps as soon as you board.
Connect to ship network app to book specialty dining or show reservations.
Inspect cabin upon keycard access and report any pre-existing damage.
Switch mobile phone settings to Airplane Mode to avoid maritime roaming rates.
